Synopsis:
    Norway's King Harald, 89, is hospitalized with a serious bacterial blood infection. His condition has deteriorated to "very serious." Crown Prince Haakon and Queen Sonja have cancelled engagements. The King previously ruled out abdication in 2024, but his deteriorating health raises implicit questions about Norwegian succession and political transition.
